acceptance: With ste_stage=enforce, a build that changes a docs/**/*.md file containing an ste-lint finding fails the build floor (a unit test in go/internal/core covers this); with shadow it only warns.
`evolve docs ste-lint --strict docs/architecture/packages/internal-modelquery.md docs/architecture/model-discovery-and-catalog.md` exits 0 with no findings.
fix: Move docs_floor.ste_stage from shadow to enforce for the loop (default in policy.DocsFloorConfig and the project .evolve/policy.json), so steLintWarn blocks a build whose changed docs/**/*.md have ste-lint findings. Do not add a second ste-lint call to go/internal/phases/ship. Then clear the findings in the two docs: 51 in internal-modelquery.md and 58 in model-discovery-and-catalog.md. Before the flip, count how many existing docs carry findings: a build that touches one would then block, so the flip may need a diff-scoped (added lines only) check first.
summary: Wave 101's cycle shipped docs that fail `evolve docs ste-lint --strict`: internal-modelquery.md:43 has a 32-word sentence, and model-discovery-and-catalog.md:13 has a 30-word numbered item. The build floor already runs ste-lint (core/ste_floor.go via docsFloorWarn), but the policy default docs_floor.ste_stage is "shadow", so findings only warn and never block. Console commits pass ste-lint as a rule, so cycle-shipped docs bypass the docs convention and the next console lane that diffs against main sees the findings.
title: The build floor's ste-lint runs in shadow, so loop cycles ship docs that fail ste-lint --strict
